newsitem.title: UK: C&W merger to be delayed, newspaper says.
newsitem.headline: C&W merger to be delayed, newspaper says.

text.p: Cable & Wireless Plc's merger with the British subsidiaries of NYNEX Corp and Bell Canada International is unlikely to meet a planned April deadline and probably will not be completed until mid-year, the Independent reported on Monday.
The newspaper, citing unnamed sources, said a clash of cultures plus the sheer complexity of the task were slowing things down.

"The difficulties have emerged as the joint steering group organising the merger, headed by C&W director Stephen Pettit, has been forced to postpone the announcement of a chief executive to run the new company, to be called Cable & Wireless Communications," the Independent said.
The newspaper said the appointment was due to be announced on January 6.
The deal was unveiled in October 1996 and is set to create the biggest cable television operator in Britain.
